product_name: Contracts Administration Platform for a Single Civil-Works Contract
summary: A prototype contracts-administration platform for a single civil-works contract in the UAE, operated in AED by a five-person team across five roles (contracts manager, quantity surveyor, site engineer, finance, client reviewer). It covers progress payment certification, retention held and released against each certificate, and delay damages assessed against the contractual completion date — all governed by contract parameters the team enters and can change in settings, since no contract document
